mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Form law (§CROSS row 3): map the in-Archon loop as kit's loop — Archon is the form, the WoD burst is the entry event, and the in-form abilities are the sustained layer. Arcane→shadow per element crosswalk default (arcane is attested: 'Archon specific abilities… Elemental Damage Type determined by your currently highest element' per skill_geometry anchor — arcane is the Wizard primary). shadow primary. No ailment attested in fetched rows. Chantodo stack-bank = two-tier-accumulator CANDIDATE: accumulate-while-out → spend-on-entry; this is the spend-tier structure. Accrual to two-tier-accumulator family filed. Vyr 6pc and Chantodo 4pc scalers are scaler-only per §B.1.

mints_anchored.description: two-tier-accumulator: a build-up -> payoff grammar where an accumulator FILLS on one action-tier (combo-beat / stack / rune-slot / charge) and DISCHARGES on a second (invoke / spend / release), the two tiers being distinct mechanics rather than one magnitude scalar. The genre's dominant 'accumulate-then-unleash' pattern; the run's largest accrual mass (~10 kits, strengthening every basin). Engine accumulator scales a single magnitude; this needs a two-tier fill/discharge substrate.
